name: Raleigh Andrean
summary: In the Undercity, Raleigh Andrean has made a home among the Forsaken. His dealings with those he once knew reveal how little regard he has for his human life.

sections.title: A Bitter Afterlife
sections.body: Before the Third War, Raleigh Andrean lived in Lordaeron as a human. He shared his life with his wife, Deliah, and counted Valdred Moray as a friend. Then the Scourge swept through the kingdom. Raleigh was killed and raised as a mindless thrall in service to the Lich King. When the Lich King's grip shattered, Sylvanas Windrunner led an uprising. Raleigh regained his free will and joined the Forsaken in the Undercity.

sections.title: Vengeance over Grief
sections.body: Raleigh Andrean's requests show how undeath has worn away his feelings. When Deliah's wedding ring is brought to him, he shows no sorrow or lingering love for his late wife. Instead, he dismisses her death and asks for the severed hands of Valdred Moray, his former friend who murdered her. Raleigh keeps the hands as a reminder of betrayal, not out of affection for Deliah. Whoever helps him receives a ring forged of pure scorn.

faq.answer: Raleigh Andrean lives among the Forsaken in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity.

faq.q: Who was Raleigh when he was alive?
faq.answer: Before the Scourge swept through Lordaeron, Raleigh lived there as a human. He was married to Deliah and counted Valdred Moray as a friend.

faq.q: Why does Raleigh want revenge on Valdred Moray?
faq.answer: Raleigh wants revenge because his former friend, Valdred Moray, murdered Deliah. He asks for Valdred's severed hands.

faq.q: How did Raleigh become free from the Scourge?
faq.answer: During the Third War, the Scourge killed Raleigh and raised him as a thrall. After the Lich King's grip shattered, Sylvanas Windrunner led an uprising that freed Raleigh and many others, who formed the Forsaken.

angles.text: As an Undead, you can see how Raleigh responds to undeath through his treatment of the human ties he once held.
